decisions.statement: A page's value is worked out only for a page being created.
An entry's id is worked out whenever the entry arrives without an id.
The world is read only where the change could have a page being created or an entry arriving.
Whether a change carries either is read from the names of its paths and the bodies it has.
A guard that cannot tell reads the world rather than leaving a value unminted.
The file an entry arrives in is found by the property the file's name states.
Whether a path is such a file is answered here for a caller outside this module.
That answer is read from the index rather than from a list of paths.
A line with no object is left alone.
An entry's id goes in first in the entry.
A property the page already states is left alone.
Only a value worked out before the checks is put in here.
The rest waits until a commit is certain.
A generator kind nothing here can work out is refused.
An index that will not answer works nothing out.
A caller can still write to a repository whose index is damaged.
A value is put in only for a property the page type declares.
A second early property can go into a page whose type declares no early property.
The checks refuse that property.
Nothing here writes a file or reaches git.
This module answers one change per body this module put a value into.
This module answers no other change.

definition: the values a write does not carry, worked out and put into a page or into an entry
